sources.exec_perm: SP1's loader rejects a segment without PF_R, so its executable segment is PF_X | PF_R
sources.memory: SP1 v6.6.0 (f5a5bbf6), github.com/succinctlabs/sp1: crates/core/machine/src/operations/address.rs:84-87 (the prover requires addresses of 2^16 or more); crates/primitives/src/consts.rs:11 and crates/core/runner/src/native.rs:73 (the executor has 2^40 bytes of memory)
sources.input: SP1 has no fixed input region: read_input returns the stdin buffer that the zkevm SDK reads at startup (zkevm/)
sources.stack: zkevm/zkvm.ld:84-88: the stack grows down from __stack_top toward 0 (no stack_bottom symbol), so the profile has no stack range
